title: Teleportation transition of surface codes on a superconducting quantum processor
task: Demonstrate teleportation of surface code logical states on superconducting processor
key_results: Surface code teleportation up to distance 7 on 125-qubit processor; phase diagram threshold boosted via coherent qubit rotations injecting magic resources; duality symmetry restored
comments: Achieving logical state teleportation with code distance 7 represents significant progress toward distributed quantum computing, though scaling to larger distances remains challenging.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Coherent rotations can boost entanglement threshold by injecting non-classical magic resources
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; duality symmetry restored and threshold improved

title: Transient response of a cylindrical cavity in three-dimensional elastic space under impact loading: an analytical solution
task: Model transient dynamic response of cylindrical cavity under impact loading
key_results: 3D analytical solution via wave function expansion and Laplace transform validated against pendulum impact data; peak errors <20%; velocity peak at cavity edge 0°/180°, hoop stress peaks at 30°/150°/210°/330°
comments: The transition from 2D plane-strain assumptions to genuine 3D analysis addresses a real gap in geotechnical theory, though the 20% peak error suggests room for refinement in the inverse Laplace transform methodology.

model_io.model: 3D cylindrical cavity in elastic medium with impulse loading

hypotheses.hypothesis: Doubling cavity diameter reduces peak velocity more than peak stress
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; velocity reduced 13.4%, stress reduced 3.2%

title: Integral resonant filter-based chattering reduction in switched human-robot interaction with hybrid admittance-adaptive impedance control
task: Reduce chattering in switched hybrid admittance-impedance control via integral resonant filtering
key_results: Integral Resonant Control (IRC) filter reduces chattering index by >76% average for planar rehabilitation robot; maintains trajectory tracking accuracy and Lyapunov stability
comments: The application of structural vibration damping techniques to control switching artifacts is creative, and the 76% chattering reduction is substantial, though comparison to other advanced switching strategies (sliding mode, higher-order) is limited.

model_io.model: Hybrid admittance-adaptive impedance controller with IRC filter

hypotheses.hypothesis: IRC filter applied to control command reduces high-frequency oscillations from abrupt switching
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; >76% chattering reduction while maintaining Lyapunov stability

title: Analytical framework for corona discharge modelling at small distances integrated with established propulsion relationships
task: Develop analytical framework for corona discharge and EHD propulsion in wire-airfoil configurations
key_results: Corona discharge prediction achieves MAPE 4.13% for 20 mm gap; ionic wind impractical for large systems (500M modules for commercial jet thrust) but viable as auxiliary propulsion for small-medium platforms
comments: The rigorous analytical validation against experimental data (4.13% error) is commendable, but the practical utility conclusion—that ionic wind is unsuitable for manned aircraft—limits immediate application impact.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Analytical approximation for corona discharge at small distances (<20 mm) predicts experimental behavior within 5% error
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; MAPE 4.13% validates step-by-step analytical approach

title: Perfect supercurrent diode efficiency in chiral nanotube based weak links
task: Achieve perfect supercurrent diode efficiency in chiral nanotube weak links
key_results: Perfect diode effect and anomalous phase develop with parallel magnetic field despite absent spin-orbit coupling; persistent currents from Little-Parks effect enable high-efficiency SDE without higher-order pair tunneling
comments: The theoretical prediction of perfect diode efficiency from geometric effects alone is elegant, though experimental validation remains pending.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Persistent currents can activate SDE independently of higher-order pair tunneling
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; Little-Parks effect provides SDE mechanism

hypotheses.hypothesis: SDE is independent of anomalous phase
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via theoretical analysis
